p.i: Rellinquet, unco cum fera bestia Impacto ad Orcisulphuream domum Descenderit cum Pseudouate, Perpetuum stygias paludes Culturi, amico more loquacibus Ranis, profundo hic scilicet in luto Iugem coaxabunt querelam Cum veteri Pharío[?] tyranno. Tunc nos fidelis Christicolum cohors Qua laude coelum implebimus & solum! Quàm multa linguae caesa plectro Bucula cum validis iuuencis Altare producetur ad aureum! Tunc terga vatum conueniet novo Curvare desueta ut labore Materiam superare tentent, Stylo revincto, seu placeat vago. Tunc tunc fidem depromere Teiam[?] Tempus, Melissæque chordæ Pindaricos dare Dithyrambos. Jam nunc atroces proijce Nænias, Et triste commuta Helciadæ melos Cum sacuları[?] cantilena Amramidæ Iacomote, & Agni.

page.notes: Verse is italic throughout, so the whole passage is in one paragraph in the italic font with lines separated by line breaks; stanza breaks are not visible on the page. Uncertain readings: "Pharío" (possibly Pharao or Pharío), "Teiam" (possibly Telam), "sacuları" (saecuları or saecularis), and "proijce" kept as printed. "Pseudouate" and "Helciadæ" are kept as printed. The catchword "IOAN-" is the start of the next page's first word.
